findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_payee, lint_endpoint, quote_check, listing_guard, check_listing, check_endpoint · Private data: preflight_payment, check_payee, lint_endpoint, check_token, payment_receipt, verify_payee_binding, quote_check, listing_guard, check_listing, security_check, seller_index, domain_auth, check_endpoint, wallet_statement, find_rv_stations, size_solar · Public sink: preflight_payment, check_payee, lint_endpoint, check_token, payment_receipt, verify_payee_binding, quote_check, listing_guard, check_listing, security_check, seller_index, domain_auth, check_endpoint, wallet_statement, find_rv_stations, size_solar · Destructive: wallet_statement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_payee, lint_endpoint, quote_check, listing_guard, check_listing, check_endpoint · Private data: preflight_payment, check_payee, lint_endpoint, check_token, payment_receipt, verify_payee_binding, quote_check, listing_guard, check_listing, security_check, seller_index, domain_auth, check_endpoint, wallet_statement, find_rv_stations, size_solar · Public sink: preflight_payment, check_payee, lint_endpoint, check_token, payment_receipt, verify_payee_binding, quote_check, listing_guard, check_listing, security_check, seller_index, domain_auth, check_endpoint, wallet_statement, find_rv_stations, size_solar · Destructive: wallet_statement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
